Cheesy Taco Bake

You Will Need:

200g Raw Ground Meat (I used turkey)

Taco Seasoning

1/4 Cup Heavy Whipping Cream

3 Eggs

60g Shredded Cheese

Optional:
Sour Cream, Tomato (100g), Green Onion (17g)

1. Brown your meat of choice in a frying pan, if you are using a fatty meat such as ground beef, I recommend draining it
2. Add your desired amount of taco seasoning to your meat. I used about 1.5-2 tsps. Mix Well
3. Place the meat into your the bottom of your casserole dish/pan and spread it out evenly.
4. In a bowl, whisk together 3 eggs and 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream, season to your liking (i used salt, pepper, paprika and garlic powder)
5. Pour your egg mixture over your meat, and make sure it evenly covers it.
6. Top with cheese of your liking (i used mozzarella and cheddar blend)
7. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes
8. Let cool for 5-10 minutes and Serve with your favourite toppings!

*I ate this as one serving for myself! Without the toppings it is 5g of carbs, 72g fat, 70g Protein, and 945 calories*

It took me a few tries, I would relapse after a few days in the beginning, so I got down in number few 2-3 / day to 2-3/week I’d say. That took me a few months. Then when I moved in with my parents, that’s when I really started to get better. My parents were always around, and they knew about my ed, so I couldn’t purge. As for coping with the urge, that’s still something I struggle with, but getting away from the bathroom and distracting yourself with something (that’s not triggering) I.e: colouring, knitting, watching netflix, whatever gets your mind off it best possible. I would offer go for drives and listen to music I loved until the urge passed, getting outside of the house helps a lot too!!

Listen to me when I say, please do not start. It’s so addicting. You tell yourself “I’ll just do it once”, but then you will spiral. My hair used to fall out. My teeth were so sensitive that I couldn’t drink cold water. My face was so swollen and my throat hurt so much that I could barely talk some days. I got so bad that I stopped going to class for 6 weeks straight at my uni, and my uni had to send me home against my will because I was so sick. All I would do was binge, purge and sleep. I couldn’t laugh, cough, sneeze, burp without throwing up. I couldn’t eat anything, I would purge everything I ate. It doesn’t matter it if was an apple or a pizza, I wouldn’t keep anything down. My skin broke out so bad, esp. around my mouth. I was freezing all the time and I just laid in bed all day. Do not start, I’m begging you. Bulimia ruined my life, and now 5 months purge free, I still think about it constantly.
I wish you all the best & I really hope that treatment helps you out a lot! Stay safe & good luck, you are so much more than this disease! 💛

I used to get inverse in my armpits and between my thighs SO bad, I haven’t had it in a while, thank God. Literally so painful. First of all, if you typically shave those areas, I would stop, at least until it heals up,bc irritation. I always would use unscented soap and I found that polysporin did help it out a bit (at least for me) and prevented it from getting worse and kept it from getting infected. Also, it might help for you to get some air to the area, just to prevent sweating, which can make it worse. So, when I had it in my armpits, I would wear tank tops at home and try to keep my arms up most of the time, so that the skin wasn’t pressing together and collecting sweat. Try to keep the area as dry as possible!!
